Your shirt, step by step.

Visit us in store or book a free appointment at your home, office or hotel in Rome.

Frequently asked questions

How much does a bespoke shirt cost in Rome?

Bespoke shirts for men and women start at €55. Visits to your address in Rome are free.

Where can I get measured?

Visit either of our Rome stores, at Via Nomentana 153 or Via Venti Settembre 58D. You can also book a free visit to your home, office or hotel in Rome.

Can I see the fabrics before choosing?

Yes. Browse the swatch book and feel the fabrics in store or during your visit. There are solids, stripes and checks.

How do I book an appointment?

Message us on WhatsApp or call +39 345 235 7524 to arrange where to meet.

How do I get my shirt when it’s ready?

Collect it in store for free or have it delivered to your address for €10.

Shall we book an appointment?

Book on WhatsApp +39 345 235 7524
